channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: AI-triggered rapid response alerts linked to lower inpatient mortality
item.description: Nahass and colleagues studied an AI-powered electronic alert system that automatically activated the rapid response team.

item.title: PTSD linked to higher risk of mild cognitive impairment and dementia in US veterans
item.description: Among US veterans, PTSD and health-related social needs were independently associated with a higher hazard.

item.title: Expert witness misconstrued patient autonomy
item.description: A medical expert for the plaintiff attorney is most credited for the outcome in a widely publicized obstetric malpractice case against an academic medical center.

item.title: England expands free flu vaccination to homeless people
item.description: Pop-up clinics and mobile vans will bring vaccination to rough-sleeping hotspots, with GP registration possible without proof of address.
